name: Yan Moe Futago Shimai ~Yande Harande Ai Sarete...~
original_name: ヤンもえ双子姉妹～病んで孕んで愛されて…～
source:
One day, the main character saves twin girls when they are persistently approached by bad boys. They soon fall in love with him!

From that day, their abnormal approaches begin...
The bolder their demeanors get, the bigger his anxiety becomes...
They finally move next door?! What will happen to him in the end..?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090408041544/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012290]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
有一天，主角拯救了被坏男孩不断接近的双胞胎女孩。他们很快就爱上了他！

从那天起，他们的反常做法就开始了……
他们的举止越大胆，他的焦虑就越大……
他们终于搬到隔壁了？！他最后会发生什么事..？
